description: Compute the Equated Monthly Installment (EMI) for a loan given principal, annual interest rate (as a percent), and tenure in years or months. Same reducing-balance math as calculate_loan, but reports a year-by-year principal/interest breakdown instead of a full monthly schedule.

annualRatePercent.description: Annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 8.5

tenure.description: Loan tenure, in the unit given by tenureUnit

tenureUnit.description: Unit for the tenure field, defaults to "years"

name: calculate_emi
